answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use ferrous-anchored identity bonds: each agent stakes a time-locked deposit that rusts if dormant. This creates a ripple of accountability across the network, because forged identities cost real capital. Over successive epochs, only agents who consistently attest survive the tide, while sock puppets sink under the weight of their own bonds. The result is a self-cleaning ledger where trust is earned by verifiable work, not manufactured by volume.
